previousRule: The new verified deployment command invoked Vercel CLI link when project metadata was absent. The CLI modified the verified export's .gitignore and created .env.local, so the full audit correctly stopped the first release attempt before deployment.
newRule: The deployment command writes only the fixed, non-secret project and team IDs into .vercel/project.json. It then rechecks the entire export and immutable asset guard before invoking Vercel deploy. No CLI link operation may mutate the source package.
reason: A release safeguard must work on a fresh export without weakening the unexpected-file check. Vercel link's side effects are unrelated to the Git tree and would make every first deployment fail or tempt an unsafe audit exception.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner requested a permanent fail-closed production safeguard and authorized completion of the release. This protected follow-up requires a new Nylon1 exact-current-head comment before merge.
